# @local/dsh-session-manager
**会话管理** —— 在设置里搜索已归档的会话记录，看它们占了多少磁盘，然后多选恢复或永久删除。
A **Session Manager** page inside Settings that lists archived Harness sessions and lets you inspect
, restore, and permanently delete them — with search and multi-select batch actions.
## What it does
- **Archived-only view** — unarchived sessions are never shown; the page is the place where archived

records are managed.
- **Search** — filters the list by title, workspace path, or session id (liter

al, case-insensitive).
- **Multi-select** — select all / per-row checkboxes, then act on the selecti

on.
- **Restore** — unarchives the selected sessions; they return to the conversation list in their

workspace.
- **Delete** — permanently removes the durable session log, its projection-cache checkpoi
nt, and its workspace membership entry. Destructive actions ask for confirmation and show the reclai

med size afterwards.
- **Size and totals** — each row shows the on-disk size of the session log; the
page shows the total held by archived sessions.
## Behavior and limits worth knowing
- **Deletion is real and immediate**: the session's log directory under `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>
/<session-id>/`, its `session_projcache` checkpoint, and its Workspace `sessionIds` entry are remove

d in one request.
- **A session that is currently running a turn cannot be deleted** — stop it first

. (An idle session that merely stays resident in memory is deletable.)
- **Resident sessions leave a
memory-only shell**: the harness keeps opened sessions in process memory and offers no public unloa
d API. After deletion the record no longer resolves to any data, and the plugin keeps its archive en
try (which is what hides it) until the next start; the startup drain then drops that final entry. Re

start the app once for the leftover entry to disappear from the sidebar's archived group.
- **Conten
t search is not available**: the shipped full-text backend is not mounted for the main query service
(`openAt: never`), so search covers metadata only. A literal-content search could be added on top o

f `sessionQuery.filterEvents`, at the cost of reading every archived log.
- **Running-time queueing*
*: if a log cannot be removed at request time (rare — e.g. another handle holds it), the id is queue
d in `~/.dsh/storages/session-manager/pending-deletions.json` and retried on the next start.
## Files
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: registers `/session-manager/{list,restore,delete}` on the host `webServer`
; reads the corpus through `ctx.sessionQuery`, edits the live `workspace` domain for membership, rem

oves storage directories. |
| `client.js` | Web half: registers the `settings.section` page, its sty

les, and the nav glyph replacement. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `session-manager` Loader ro

w. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Display metadata shown by Plugin Manager and Settings. |
| `icon.svg` | Original line-style mark. |
## Install
Install the package directory through Plugin Manager (`install_bundle`), or add it to a profile's bu
ndle list. Host-side code changes require an app restart; client code reloads with the page when the
host re-serves the bundle.
